sloka: स्थितह् ककुद्मानिव तीक्ष्णशृङ्गो ।महाचलः श्वेत इवोच्चशृङ्गः ।हस्तीव जाम्बूनदबद्धश्^इङ्गो ।रराज चन्द्रह् परिपूर्णशृङ्गः ॥५-५-५॥
transliteration: sthitah kakudmāniva tīkṣṇaśṛṅgo ।mahācalaḥ śveta ivoccaśṛṅgaḥ ।hastīva jāmbūnadabaddhaś^iṅgo ।rarāja candrah paripūrṇaśṛṅgaḥ ॥5-5-5॥

translations.english: The fullmoon with its hornlike spot shone like a bull with sharp horns, like the white Himalayan mountain with its lofty peaks, and like an elephant with gold plated tusks
